scope: Evidence provenance, numerical transcription, units and scope guards; not independent professional review, deployed smoke or real iPhone acceptance

results.name: Exact seven v11 IDs, no new queue or HDR inflation
Original texts, versions, source hashes and status preserved
Historical protected files are byte-identical
All seven distinguish bounded support, unresolved extensions and minimal revision
Source provenance and actual reading limits present; no fabricated paragraph pagination
NIST form/list cannot become a numerical stopping-power table
Paired planning n20 is distinct from clinical cohort n152
Same-study V5 values, units, SD and percentage-point differences remain reproducible
Planning comparison retains platform/normalization confounds, not universal clinical causality
MPPG2b millimetre values are equipment QA, never patient action thresholds
Active AAPM directory, full text and Chinese legal force are distinct
Initial review and IMRT QA before first fraction retain emergency exception and change review
IGRT remains X-ray equipment scope with online/offline and residual-motion caveats
Particle figures retain exact energies and conditions, no invented tail percentages
Feigley original Eq2.1 is C not DeltaC; image verification does not rewrite v11 failure
Background mass balance and example arithmetic with unit conversion, reject invalid flow
HEPA rating and CADR retain particle, residential and ceiling boundaries
ASHRAE metadata-only record cannot claim consolidated clauses or numerical requirements
Actual retrieval failures preserved independently of later successful alternative reads
No publication, real data access, expert approval, fee or final 2028 claim
